summary: The Children's Place filed an 8-K confirming a $25.0 million fourth Mithaq term loan drawn under its $40.0 million commitment letter with Mithaq Capital SPC, dated May 2, 2024. Funds were received September 24, 2026, permanently exhausting the facility. The note matures April 16, 2031, bears one-month SOFR plus 9.00%, paid monthly but deferrable, is unsecured and guaranteed by subsidiary guarantors, and is subordinated to the Wells Fargo $350.0 million revolver and SLR $100.0 million term loan. Watch liquidity and covenant headroom.
